# Felix Scholze — webshaped.de

> Personal blog covering software development, web technology, and related topics. Content is served from a WordPress backend via GraphQL and rendered with Astro (SSR) and Vue islands.

- Available in German (`/de/`, default) and English (`/en/`).
- Blog posts are dynamically served pages, not static files, so this list covers site sections rather than individual articles.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://webshaped.de/): Latest posts and site overview.
- [RSS Feed](https://webshaped.de/rss/): Full post feed for syndication.
